newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:

Net sales of 113,000 MT were up one-half from the previous week and one-third above the 4-week average. The major buyers were Japan (54,300 MT), Mexico (31,800 MT), and Turkey (30,100 MT). Decreases of 21,900 MT were reported for unknown destinations. Exports of 195,200 MT--a marketing-year high--improved 11 percent from the prior week and 77 percent from the 4-week average. Japan (113,600 MT) was the primary destination.
